github_completion_rule: GitHub search exposes at most 1,000 results per query. If total_count exceeds 1,000, page 10 is full while more results remain, any page reports incomplete_results=true, pagination/total_count is inconsistent, or HTTP/API/rate failure prevents exhaustion, stop without freezing a pool. Resume the same requests after rate recovery; unauthenticated rate limits never count as candidate exclusions. Do not silently tighten query, select top-ranked hits, or claim completeness from a partial result. De-duplicate by GitHub repository identity and record every search occurrence.

candidate_union: Every distinct repository in either complete search plus every named seed; a seed remains in the union even if neither search finds it. Record all source IDs and seed provenance per repository. No post-result additions to this r2 union.
pin_rule: For each union repository, request repository metadata and GitHub latest published release. Resolve that release tag, peeling annotated tags to the full commit; if no published release exists, resolve the default branch HEAD to the full commit. Freeze that SHA before tree, license, or shader work; never follow a moving branch or tag during measurement. Deleted/unresolvable repositories remain recorded with a retrieval-error disposition and block a complete freeze until resolved or explicitly reviewed before measurement.
metadata_rule: At the pinned commit, fetch the complete recursive Git tree. Require truncated=false; otherwise use deterministic tree-by-tree traversal until every entry is accounted for or stop incomplete. Count regular Git blobs only, preserving distinct path occurrences. Selected population is every exact lowercase .slang or .slangh regular file in the entire repository. Count selected files and selected blob bytes. Symlinks and gitlinks are counted separately but not followed. No subpath, parse-result, compiler-success, filename, or file-size filtering. Record root license expression and pinned license blob hash; inspect per-file terms before admission. Metadata only; do not fetch shader bodies or measure.

eligibility.language: Confirm shader-slang GPU Slang from repository primary documentation or pinned metadata. Same-suffix RetroArch shader packs, SystemVerilog slang, and other languages receive wrong-language disposition, with evidence; suffix or GitHub language label alone is insufficient.
eligibility.license: Pinned root terms must provide an OSI-approved grant (including an OSI-approved base with a permissive exception). Missing terms or a non-OSI grant receive license-excluded with the concrete evidence, never an inferred permission. Conflicting or ambiguous terms receive unresolved-stop pending clarification. Per-file conflicting terms are an admission stop before measurement, never an outcome-based file removal.
eligibility.size: At least one selected regular file; at most 5,000 selected files and at most 50,000,000 selected blob bytes across the whole repository. The size ceiling applies to selected suffix content, not all repository files, so a roughly 90 MB Vulkan-Samples repository can qualify without trimming paths. No arbitrary whole-checkout byte limit changes membership; if retrieval is impractical, record an operational stop and seek a metadata-preserving retrieval method before measurement.
eligibility.role: Nonempty eligible production, application, and sample projects enter the candidate measurement population. The compiler implementation and its intentional regression fixtures are diagnostic by predeclared role; an empty specification repository is zero-population. No project becomes diagnostic because its grammar rate is hard.

disposition_record: Emit one row for every union repository, including every search hit and seed, with full_name, sources/page/rank, pin and metadata receipts, language evidence, root/per-file license state, selected count/bytes, and exactly one final disposition: eligible-primary, eligible-holdout, diagnostic-role, wrong-language, zero-population, license-excluded, size-excluded, or unresolved-stop. Record all applicable exclusion reasons in addition to the final disposition. A missing disposition or unresolved-stop prevents complete freeze.
role_assignment: After all eligible metadata are frozen, reserve the eligible production/application/sample repository with the largest selected-file count as one whole-project holdout (tie: lexicographically smallest full_name); all other eligible projects are primary. Publish the identity, pin, counts, and zero/duplicate blob overlap. Both groups retain every selected file and are measured separately on the same frozen grammar revision. The holdout never enters canonical shards or primary aggregation.
future_gate: At most 5% ERROR-or-MISSING files and at most 0.1% faults on the whole fixed primary pool AND separately on the whole fixed holdout. Report both rates and per-project counts beside any proposed level or change note; no level may claim more than either group supports. Independent reading, coverage, and performance proof remain additional requirements. No measurement is authorized by this preregistration.

freeze_order: Commit this search rule first. Then execute metadata search, save raw responses under ignored workspace/, record every disposition and receipt, derive and commit the r2 subject inventory and pool rule with updated digests, and only then seek NP-Q5 authorization for measurement. Do not mutate the existing pool-rule.json, generated files, or canonical queue while enumeration is in progress.
reach_boundary: A prospective reach-focused search: at least 100 GitHub stars at search time, plus the explicit 11 seed repositories regardless of stars. This bound is fixed before the r2 result set is fetched and is not a claim to enumerate every Slang project.
